headword: {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}

definitions.gloss: proof of delivery; delivery certification; certified delivery
definitions.explanation: A postal service that provides the sender with official proof that a letter or package was delivered to the recipient. In Japan, this is a service offered by Japan Post for registered mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: Since it was an important document, I sent it with proof of delivery.

examples.japanese: {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{日時|にちじ}→日時：00316_nichiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記録|きろく}される→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: When you add delivery certification, the date and time of delivery are recorded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}→解除：05762_kaijo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{内容証明|ないようしょうめい}⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It is common to send a contract cancellation notice by certified content mail with delivery certification.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧ (delivery) and ⟦{証明|しょうめい}→証明：03242_shoumei⟧ (proof, certification). Refers to a Japan Post service that provides the sender with a postcard confirming when the item was delivered.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ — to add delivery certification
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ — to send with proof of delivery
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ — certified delivery mail
- {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい}⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ — with delivery certification attached

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{書留|かきとめ}→書留：00150_kakitome⟧ — registered mail (tracked and insured; {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい} is an add-on to this)
- {内容証明|ないようしょうめい} — certified content mail (certifies what was written in the letter; often combined with {配達証明|はいたつしょうめい})
- ⟦{速達|そくたつ}→速達：04393_sokutatsu⟧ — express delivery
- ⟦{普通郵便|ふつうゆうびん}→普通郵便：25818_futsuuyuubin⟧ — regular mail

PRACTICAL NOTE:
{配達証明|はいたつしょうめい} is commonly used for legal or official correspondence where the sender needs proof that a document was received. Typical uses include contract termination notices, demand letters, and formal complaints. It must be combined with ⟦{書留|かきとめ}→書留：00150_kakitome⟧ (registered mail) and cannot be used alone.
